rows.grounds: causative optative of kṛ; prescribes performance
fused accusative object koṭihomam plus enclitic tu; not split
fused instrumental plural with numeral aṣṭa; analyzed as given

items.question: Who should perform the koṭi-homa and by how many men?
items.inference: the rite requires eight male performers
uncertainties: fused sandhi in koṭihomantu and puruṣairaṣṭabhiḥ is analyzed without expansion
exact morphological split of the fused forms is inferred
items.plain_english: Thus one should have the koṭi-homa performed by eight men.
